CREATE TABLE "public"."Deposit" (
  "amountPaisa" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "exactAmountPaisa" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentAccountId" text,
  "paymentAccountName" text NOT NULL,
  "paymentAccountNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "planId" text,
  "processingChargePaisa" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "proofUrl" text NOT NULL,
  "rejectionReason" text,
  "reviewedAt" timestamptz,
  "reviewedBy" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "transactionReference" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Deposit_status_check_56005a61" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Investment" (
  "amountPaisa" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "earnedProfitPaisa" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "endDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "frequency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "nextProfitAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "planId" text NOT NULL,
  "profitRateBps" int4 NOT NULL,
  "startDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Investment_frequency_check_4cc8f810" CHECK ("frequency" IN ('DAILY', 'WEEKLY', 'MONTHLY')),
  CONSTRAINT "Investment_status_check_7337ba71" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."InvestmentPlan" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customWithdrawalLimitsEnabled" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "dailyWithdrawalLimitPaisa" int4,
  "durationDays" int4 NOT NULL,
  "frequency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "lifetimeWithdrawalLimitPaisa" int4,
  "maxAmountPaisa" int4 NOT NULL,
  "minAmountPaisa" int4 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "profitRateBps" int4 NOT NULL,
  "referralBonusBps" int4 DEFAULT 1400 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "InvestmentPlan_frequency_check_4cc8f810" CHECK ("frequency" IN ('DAILY', 'WEEKLY', 'MONTHLY'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Notification" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isRead" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text DEFAULT 'INFO' NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PaymentAccount" (
  "accountName" text NOT NULL,
  "accountNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "gateway" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "processingChargePaisa" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "PaymentAccount_gateway_check_2e4795dc" CHECK ("gateway" IN ('EASYPAISA', 'BANK', 'RAAST'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Referral" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "level" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "referredUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "referrerId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ReferralCommission" (
  "baseAmountPaisa" int4 NOT NULL,
  "commissionAmountPaisa" int4 NOT NULL,
  "commissionRateBps" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "investmentId" text,
  "level" int4 NOT NULL,
  "receiverId" text NOT NULL,
  "sourceUserId" text NOT NULL,
  "transactionId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."ReferralSetting" (
  "id" text DEFAULT 'default' NOT NULL,
  "level1BonusBps" int4 DEFAULT 1300 NOT NULL,
  "level2BonusBps" int4 DEFAULT 500 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Transaction" (
  "amountPaisa" int4 NOT NULL,
  "balanceAfterPaisa" int4 NOT NULL,
  "balanceBeforePaisa" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "depositId" text,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "investmentId" text,
  "referenceId" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "withdrawalId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Transaction_type_check_e1d6d09b" CHECK ("type" IN ('DEPOSIT', 'WITHDRAWAL', 'INVESTMENT', 'PROFIT', 'REFERRAL_COMMISSION', 'REFUND'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "balancePaisa" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerifiedAt" timestamptz,
  "fullName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "isEmailVerified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "referralCode" text NOT NULL,
  "referralLevel" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'USER' NOT NULL,
  "totalInvestmentPaisa" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "totalProfitPaisa" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "totalReferralPaisa" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "totalWithdrawnPaisa" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "User_role_check_1954e8c0" CHECK ("role" IN ('USER', 'ADMIN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UserWithdrawalSetting" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dailyLimitPaisa" int4,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isEnabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."VerificationToken" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "usedAt" timestamptz,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "VerificationToken_type_check_5a4470d6" CHECK ("type" IN ('EMAIL_VERIFICATION', 'PASSWORD_RESET'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Withdrawal" (
  "accountDetails" json NOT NULL,
  "amountPaisa" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "planId" text,
  "rejectionReason" text,
  "reviewedAt" timestamptz,
  "reviewedBy" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Withdrawal_status_check_56005a61" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WithdrawalSetting" (
  "defaultDailyLimitPaisa" int4,
  "defaultLifetimeLimitPaisa" int4,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "minWithdrawalPaisa" int4 DEFAULT 50000 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
